name: feature.crm.nodes
description: CRM feature node pack — contact-triage nodes (the two basic/enriched variants back the CRM toggle's A/B bindings) PLUS the full ctx.features.crm surface: ten role:"action" read nodes (companies / deals / tasks / a saved segment's live members / suppression-cause analytics / bookings / sign status / one contact) and fifteen role:"side-effect" write nodes (record a triage result, create/update contacts, convert a lead, create companies/deals, move a deal's stage, create/complete tasks, log an activity, sync Gmail). Every write calls the SAME service function the HTTP routes call, emitting the same host event + audit row — agent/workflow writes and human writes are indistinguishable to the audit trail. Creation nodes default to a deterministic `<prefix>:<runId>:<nodeId>` id when the caller omits one — a PER-RUN dedupe key (a retried node converges), NOT a cross-run fork guard. v1.4.0 adds `gmail-sync` (scheduler-fired Gmail inbox → CRM activity sync, refs-only metadata, matched contacts only, never creates) and `suppression-summary`…
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: CRM Triage (basic)
nodes.description: Rule-based contact triage — scores a contact from its stage; v1.1.0 (ADR 0837 D7) reads `inputs.variant` (`basic` | `enriched`, default `basic`) so the run that `crm-ops.triage` starts scores by the variant its toggle assignment stamped. The `basic` variant binding.

nodes.label: CRM Triage (enriched)
nodes.description: Enriched contact triage — adds company-signal weighting. The `enriched` variant binding.

nodes.label: CRM: List Companies
nodes.description: Lists an org's CRM companies over ctx.features.crm.listCompanies. Inputs: { orgId, q? }. Output: { companies }. Tenant+org-guarded (CTI-1).

nodes.label: CRM: Get Company
nodes.description: Fetches one CRM company by id over ctx.features.crm.getCompany. Inputs: { orgId, companyId }. Output: { company } (null when absent). Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Get Contact
nodes.description: Fetches one CRM contact by id over ctx.features.crm.getContact (ADR 0837 D7). Inputs: { contactId }. Output: { contact } (null when absent or merged away). Tenant-guarded; contacts are the tenant-wide rolodex.

nodes.label: CRM: Suppression Summary
nodes.description: Suppression-cause analytics over ctx.features.crm.suppressionSummary (ADR 0251): counts by reason (unsubscribed/bounced/complaint/manual) + coarse source bucket + newest timestamp. No inputs. Output: { summary }. Counts only — no addresses (no PII).

nodes.label: CRM: List Deals
nodes.description: Lists an org's CRM deals over ctx.features.crm.listDeals. Inputs: { orgId, pipelineId?, stageId?, companyId?, q? }. Output: { deals }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Get Deal
nodes.description: Fetches one CRM deal by id over ctx.features.crm.getDeal. Inputs: { orgId, dealId }. Output: { deal } (null when absent). Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: List Tasks
nodes.description: Lists an org's CRM tasks over ctx.features.crm.listTasks. Inputs: { orgId, status?, dealId? }. Output: { tasks }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Create Contact
nodes.description: Creates (or, given an explicit contactId that already exists, idempotently returns) a tenant-scoped contact over ctx.features.crm.createContact. Inputs: { contactId?, name, email?, company?, stage?, owner?, title?, address?, leadSource?, phone? } (CRM-2: title/address/leadSource are first-class strings validated fail-closed; phone upserts the phone identifier, the identity-resolution SoT — never a stored scalar). Output: { success, contact } (a read-only derived `phone` is surfaced from the identifier). Explicit id MUST be `crm:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `crm:${runId}:${nodeId}`.

nodes.label: CRM: Update Contact Stage
nodes.description: Advances/sets a contact's lifecycle stage over ctx.features.crm.updateContactStage. Inputs: { contactId, stage }. Output: { success, contact }. Tenant-guarded; refuses a tombstoned (merged-away) contact.

nodes.label: CRM: Update Contact Owner
nodes.description: Reassigns a contact's owner over ctx.features.crm.updateContactOwner. Inputs: { contactId, owner } — `contactId` falls back to `entityId` so this node can be driven directly off a `host.crm.contact.created` trigger edge (the ids-only event payload). Output: { success, contact }. Tenant-guarded; refuses a tombstoned contact.

nodes.label: CRM: Convert Contact
nodes.description: ADR 0209 §3 lead conversion — get-or-creates a company + deal for the contact and advances its stage, over ctx.features.crm.convertContact. Inputs: { contactId, orgId, companyName?, pipelineId?, dealTitle? }. Output: { success, contact, company, deal, created }. Idempotent-by-outcome (a re-convert reuses the existing open deal). Tenant+org-guarded; refuses a tombstoned contact.

nodes.label: CRM: Create Company
nodes.description: Creates (or idempotently returns, given an existing explicit id) an org-scoped company over ctx.features.crm.createCompany. Inputs: { orgId, companyId?, name, domain?, size?, revenue? } (CRM-2: size = employee count, revenue = annual revenue in major units; both validated fail-closed). Output: { success, company }. Explicit id MUST be `cmp:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `cmp:${runId}:${nodeId}`.

nodes.label: CRM: Create Deal
nodes.description: Creates (or idempotently returns, given an existing explicit id) an org-scoped deal over ctx.features.crm.createDeal. Inputs: { orgId, dealId?, title, amount?, companyId?, contactId?, pipelineId?, stageId?, closeDate? }. Output: { success, deal }. Explicit id MUST be `deal:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `deal:${runId}:${nodeId}`. Tenant+org link validation (companyId/contactId) applies.

nodes.label: CRM: Move Deal Stage
nodes.description: Moves a deal to a new pipeline stage over ctx.features.crm.moveDealStage, deriving the deal's outcome from the stage name (won/lost) exactly as the org route does. Inputs: { orgId, dealId, stageId }. Output: { success, deal }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Create Task
nodes.description: Creates (or idempotently returns, given an existing explicit id) an org-scoped task over ctx.features.crm.createTask. Inputs: { orgId, taskId?, title, dueDate?, dealId? }. Output: { success, task }. Explicit id MUST be `task:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `task:${runId}:${nodeId}`.

nodes.label: CRM: Complete Task
nodes.description: Marks a task done over ctx.features.crm.completeTask. Inputs: { orgId, taskId }. Output: { success, task }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Log Activity
nodes.description: Appends a note/call/email/meeting to a deal/contact/company's timeline over ctx.features.crm.logActivity (append-only — no update/delete). Inputs: { orgId, activityId?, kind, body, dealId?, contactId?, companyId? }. Output: { success, activity }. Explicit id MUST be `act:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `act:${runId}:${nodeId}`. Tenant+org link validation applies.

nodes.label: CRM: List Segment Members
nodes.description: Resolves a saved segment's LIVE membership over ctx.features.crm.listSegmentMembers (ADR 0211 §2) — evaluated at read against the tenant rolodex; membership is never materialized. Inputs: { segmentId }. Output: { members }. Tenant-guarded.

nodes.label: CRM: Gmail Inbox Sync
nodes.description: ADR 0252 — scheduler-fired Gmail inbox → CRM activity sync. Reads gmailSyncId from ctx.config (frozen in at chain expansion, RFC 0013 Path A), resolves the opt-in row over ctx.features.crm.getGmailSyncForRun, pages (nextPageToken, bounded) the connected user's recent Gmail messages via ctx.connectors.invoke('google', …), matches From/To participants to EXISTING CRM contacts only (ctx.features.crm.findContactByEmail — never creates), and appends metadata-only email activities (no subject/body/snippet/email, back-dated to the email's own time) via ctx.features.crm.logGmailActivity. Every connector invoke PINS the sync row's owner-verified `connectionId` (ADR 0627 D5 — the broker never falls through to an org/workspace credential). Advances the sync's time cursor only past messages whose every append returned `logged | duplicate` (the typed ctx.features.crm.logGmailActivity outcome); a `capped` outcome pauses the sync (`status:'paused', pausedReason:'capped'`) and a refused pin marks it `needs-reconsent` via ctx.features.crm.markGmailSyncRunStatus. Refuses (typed failure) a sync that is already paused or needs-reconsent. Inputs: { gmailSyncId }. Output: { scanned, matched (appends actually LOGGED — duplicates excluded), truncated }. truncated=true holds the cursor and persists a scan window (`scan.before`/`scan.newest`, via ctx.features.crm.recordGmailSyncScan) so later passes drain BELOW what was reached instead of re-listing the same newest 500; an unsettled message holds the cursor for at most 5 passes, then is released with a warn naming the id. Requires ctx.connectors (host_capability_missing otherwise) + a `google` connection (gmail.readonly) bound to the sync's owning user.

nodes.label: CRM: Segment Vocabulary
nodes.description: Reads the legal segment-filter vocabulary over ctx.features.crm.segmentVocabulary (ADR 0265 CDP-C) — the closed-world grounding for drafting segment filters. No inputs. Deterministic (code constants) — role:pure.

nodes.label: CRM: Validate Segment
nodes.description: Validates a draft segment filter set over ctx.features.crm.validateSegment (non-throwing — returns the validation result for a draft→validate loop). Inputs: { filters }. Deterministic — role:pure.

nodes.label: CRM: Persist Segment
nodes.description: Persists a validated segment over ctx.features.crm.persistSegment (ADR 0265 CDP-C — the segment-author copilot's draft→validate→persist trio). The surface RE-VALIDATES closed-world and refuses an invalid draft WITHOUT writing (fail-closed { success:false, errors }); a saved segment is inert until wired to activation. Inputs: { name, filters, segmentId? }. Explicit id MUST be `seg:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives a deterministic `seg:${runId}:${nodeId}` (a per-run dedupe key; the side-effect classification is the fork guard). Output: { success, segment } | { success:false, errors }. Tenant-guarded. role:side-effect (ADR 0627 D1).

nodes.label: CRM: Create Booking Link
nodes.description: ADR 0402 — creates (or idempotently returns) a public booking link over ctx.features.crm.createBookingLink. Inputs: { bookingLinkId?, orgId, title, timezone, weeklyHours:[{day,start,end}], durations:[minutes], description?, status?, ownerUserId?, location?, videoLink?, bufferBeforeMin?, bufferAfterMin?, minNoticeMin?, maxAdvanceDays?, slug? }. Output: { success, bookingLink }. Explicit id MUST be `booking-link:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `booking-link:${runId}:${nodeId}` (a per-run dedupe key; the side-effect classification is the fork guard). The public slot-CLAIM is a visitor action, not a node.

nodes.label: CRM: List Bookings
nodes.description: ADR 0402 — lists an org's bookings over ctx.features.crm.listBookings. Inputs: { orgId, bookingLinkId?, status? }. Output: { bookings }. Org-scoped read.

nodes.label: CRM: Request Signature
nodes.description: ADR 0402 §b — requests native click-to-sign signatures on a commerce quote or document over ctx.features.crm.requestSignature. Inputs: { signRequestId?, orgId, target:{kind:'commerce_quote'|'document', id}, signers:[{email,name?,order?}] }. Output: { success, signRequest } (status projection: signers + audit). Binds to a SHA-256 content hash of the target at request time. Explicit id MUST be `sign-request:`-prefixed (ADR 0162); omitted, the host derives `sign-request:${runId}:${nodeId}` (a per-run dedupe key; the side-effect classification is what keeps a replay fork from re-minting signer tokens). The public SIGN action is a signer action, not a node.

nodes.label: CRM: Signature Status
nodes.description: ADR 0402 §b — reads a sign request's status over ctx.features.crm.getSignatureStatus. Inputs: { orgId, signRequestId }. Output: { signRequest } (per-signer status + audit + certificate URL when completed). Org-scoped read.

nodes.label: CRM: Record Triage
nodes.description: Records a triage result { variant, score, priority } on a contact over ctx.features.crm.recordContactTriage (ADR 0837 D7). Writes only when the contact's last-triage stamp names THIS run; otherwise answers { recorded:false, outcome:'superseded' } and changes nothing. Inputs: { contactId, triage }.

nodes.label: CRM: Grade Lead
nodes.description: Grades one client lead A–F under the client's scoring model (ADR 0954 D2) over ctx.features.crm.gradeLead, with the model version the dispatch pinned. Writes the grade only when the lead's pending run is THIS run; otherwise answers { recorded:false, outcome:'superseded' } and changes nothing. The run must have been started for this client and lead. Inputs: { orgId, contactId, modelId?, modelVersion? }.

nodes.label: CRM: Route Lead
nodes.description: Routes one client lead to an owner under the client's routing policy (ADR 0954 D5) over ctx.features.crm.routeLead: territory, round robin, capacity or a named owner, each candidate re-checked for write access on the client at assignment; nobody eligible puts the lead in the client's unassigned queue. Ledgered on (contactId, routingEpoch): a re-execution returns the recorded choice. Inputs: { orgId, contactId, routingEpoch }.

nodes.label: CRM: Speed-to-lead deadlines
nodes.description: Computes the first-touch deadlines (due, escalate, report) from the route node's recorded clock inputs and the client's business hours (ADR 0954 D6). Pure: a replay or fork recomputes the same instants. Writes slaDeadline, slaEscalateAt and slaReportAt to the run bag for the waits. Inputs: { sla } over an edge from route-lead.

nodes.label: CRM: Check first touch
nodes.description: Reads whether the routed owner touched the lead since assignment in this routing round: an activity the owner logged, or a booking made (ADR 0954 D6). Inputs: { orgId, contactId, routingEpoch }. Output: { touched, firstTouchAt? }.

nodes.label: CRM: Speed-to-lead rung
nodes.description: Fires one speed-to-lead rung once per routing round (ADR 0954 D6): 1 reminds the owner, 2 escalates to the territory manager or agency lead (or re-routes, per the client's setting), 3 tells the agency lead. Output continueClock is false once rung 2 re-routed. Ledgered, so a re-execution does nothing. Inputs: { orgId, contactId, routingEpoch, rung }.

nodes.label: CRM: Routing result
nodes.description: Returns the recorded routing outcome after every clock branch has completed or been skipped. A failed predecessor is not recovered. Pure: no CRM reads, writes or new assignment.

nodes.label: CRM: Lead evidence
nodes.description: Freezes qualification evidence once on the erasable lead primary under the admitted run. Records only opaque references and content fingerprints in events. Raw evidence reaches the assessor through the guarded CRM read surface; no caller prompt or read set grants authority.

nodes.label: CRM: Assess lead
nodes.description: Assesses the admitted run’s frozen evidence through the existing invocation-logged AI path, validates citations and immutable model criteria, and records an assessment under the same primary reservation. One repair, then typed failure. A strict replay resolves the source outcome without another write. Inputs: orgId, contactId, modelId, modelVersion.
